description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatGrain class, testing functionalities such as initialization, posting, deleting, editing, and truncating chat posts within an Orleans-based event-sourced chat application.

classes.name: ChatGrainTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the IChatGrain implementation, including post creation, deletion, editing, and truncation.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Tests the initial state of a newly created chat, verifying the presence of creation markers in the chat content.

methods.name: PostThenDelete
methods.description: Tests posting a message and then deleting it, verifying the post appears and then is removed from the chat content.

methods.name: PostThenEdit
methods.description: Tests posting multiple messages, editing one, and verifying the change is reflected in the chat content.

methods.name: Truncate
methods.description: Tests posting more messages than the maximum allowed and verifies that the chat content is truncated to the maximum number of posts.
